notes.title: 🐞Oops! Bug Fixed – Japanese Translation is Now Available! 日本語翻訳のバグ修正完了！🎌
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44518559/1c4efaf114192ed51ae84465f9c84d38b138bbc7.png[/img]
We have some exciting news to share, but first, a big thank you for your patience and understanding! 🙏 Due to a bug and a few translation mistakes on our end, the Japanese translation was missing from the game at launch. 😅 But we’re happy to announce that these issues have been fixed, and the full Japanese translation is now live! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2556000/Manhattan_Dolls/

What’s been updated:

The Japanese text is now fully integrated and polished so you can enjoy Barbara’s adventures in the heart of Manhattan 🗽
All localization errors have been addressed, making for a smoother, more immersive experience 🎌
We deeply apologize for the delay and any confusion this may have caused. We're always striving to improve and appreciate your support as we work through these challenges! 💪

Thank you again for your incredible patience, and we hope you enjoy playing Manhattan Dolls in your preferred language! ❤️

If you encounter any further issues, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here for you!
